title: Explicit finite spanning family after shrinking at a minimal prime
statement: Let φ:R→S be a finite-type homomorphism of commutative rings, p a minimal prime of R, and suppose the primes of S contracting to p form a finite set. Then there are g∉p and a finite family b₁,…,bₙ in S_{φ(g)} whose R_g-span is all of S_{φ(g)}.

source.place: Tag 02ML, lemma-generically-finite; monic polynomial and monomial spanning construction

proof.text: Use the prime-spectrum fibre equivalence to make the spectrum of p.Fiber S finite. The finite-spectrum finite-type algebra theorem gives Module.Finite over p.ResidueField. Restrict scalars along the surjective residue map from R_p, and transport across Ideal.Fiber.algEquivQuotient to obtain that S_p / pS_p is finite over R_p. This avoids lifting polynomial coefficients from the residue field.

The maximal ideal of R_p is its nilradical by minimality of p, and its extension J to S_p is contained in the nilradical. For x in S_p take a monic annihilating polynomial P for its class in the finite quotient S_p/J. Then P(x) lies in J, so P(x)^n=0 for some n. The monic polynomial P^n shows that x is integral over R_p. This argument also covers the zero quotient.

For each of finitely many algebra generators x, use IsIntegral.exists_multiple_integral_of_isLocalization to clear coefficients and IsLocalization.exists_isIntegral_smul_of_isIntegral_map to clear an annihilator. Thus m_x x is integral over R for some m_x outside p. Let g be their product. Each m_x is a unit in R_g, so each localized generator is integral over R_g. Their images still generate S_g: a fraction has numerator in the algebra they generate and its denominator inverse comes from R_g. Apply fg_adjoin_of_finite, followed by Submodule.fg_iff_exists_fin_generating_family, to obtain the required finite spanning family. For an empty set of algebra generators the product is 1; the adjoin and finite-generation results include the zero ring.

lean.statement: theorem exists_finite_span_awayMap_of_finite_fiber_minimalPrime {R : Type u} {S : Type v} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] (φ : R →+* S) (hφ : φ.FiniteType) (p : Ideal R) (hp : p ∈ minimalPrimes R) (hfinite : {q : PrimeSpectrum S | Ideal.comap φ q.asIdeal = p}.Finite) : ∃ g : R, g ∉ p ∧ letI : Algebra (Localization.Away g) (Localization.Away (φ g)) := (Localization.awayMap φ g).toAlgebra ∃ n : ℕ, ∃ b : Fin n → Localization.Away (φ g), Submodule.span (Localization.Away g) (Set.range b) = ⊤
